content: Obsidian Canvas: infinite 2D canvas, place notes/attachments/web pages, connect with lines, group. Stores as JSON Canvas open .canvas format (now an open standard with libs for many langs, gives users data ownership). tldraw/Excalidraw are MIT infinite-canvas whiteboards, local-first (IndexedDB, offline PWA, no account). None have typed entity profiles, data-driven relationship graphs, or field-scoped search.
